title: Detail page: 'More like this' rail (same genre, best-rated first)
description: A horizontal rail at the bottom of the detail page with Steam games sharing this game's primary genre, sorted by Metacritic. Cached store info only (new cachedSnapshot accessor) - it never triggers a network fetch just to decorate the page. Works in controller mode too: picking a suggestion jumps the carousel selection.
commit_message: Detail page: 'More like this' rail from cached store info
